hook: Search: a tiny open-source WebKit browser for the Mac
hookText: Search: a tiny open-source WebKit browser for the Mac

beats.say: Search is a free, open-source, about 7 MB macOS browser built on the system WebKit, with Chrome Web Store extensions, spaces, a reading mode and network-level ad blocking.
Made by the Paris design studio Office Commun, Search uses the WebKit engine that ships with macOS rather than bundling Chromium.
The site claims about 51 MB of memory before the first page versus far more for Safari and Chrome.
